<reason>CON won the scope mismatch. PRO conceded no freeze of inhabited coasts, no coastal demilitarization, no outsider vote, leaving only the central pocket, while its danger evidence was coastal militarization. CON's dilemma - thin treaty renames status quo, thick treaty unratifiable - survived, and delay-as-paperwork was never refuted as stabilizing.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A's coastal vs central distinction in Rebuttal 2: buildup is over NSR/EEZ/Kola, not the high-seas hole, so PRO's treaty misses where guns and tankers are - B's can't-have-it-both-ways reply did not re-link its evidence to its remedy.</best_rebuttal>
